questions.question: Pyridoxal phosphate (PLP), the active coenzyme form of vitamin B6, plays a critical role in amino acid transamination reactions. Prior to binding an incoming amino acid substrate, how is PLP bound to the active site of the aminotransferase enzyme?
options: An internal Schiff base (aldimine) bond formed with the epsilon-amino group of a specific lysine residue
A thioester linkage with the sulfhydryl group of an active-site cysteine residue
A phosphodiester bond linking the phosphate group of PLP to a serine residue
A coordination complex formed between the pyridine nitrogen and a catalytic zinc ion

questions.question: During the initial phase of nutritional rehabilitation in a patient with severe chronic starvation (such as advanced anorexia nervosa), refeeding syndrome can quickly develop. Which intracellular metabolic event is directly responsible for the precipitous drop in serum inorganic phosphate in these patients?
options: Upregulation of renal parathyroid hormone receptors causing elevated urinary phosphate excretion
Insulin secretion stimulating cellular uptake of glucose and immediate phosphorylation of glycolytic intermediates
Uncoupling of oxidative phosphorylation driven by rapid fatty acid oxidation
Systemic metabolic acidosis causing phosphate ions to exit cells in exchange for hydrogen ions

questions.question: Selenium is incorporated into selenoproteins, such as glutathione peroxidase and iodothyronine deiodinases, in the form of selenocysteine. Which codon on mRNA specifies the insertion of selenocysteine when accompanied by a specialized 3'-untranslated region stem-loop structure (SECIS element)?
options: UAA
UAG
UGA
UGG

questions.question: In assessing suspected thiamine deficiency, an erythrocyte transketolase activation assay is often performed. Which specific biochemical reaction in the non-oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway is directly catalyzed by this thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP)-dependent enzyme?
options: The oxidation of glucose-6-phosphate to 6-phosphoglucono-delta-lactone
The isomerization of ribulose-5-phosphate to ribose-5-phosphate
The transfer of a three-carbon dihydroxyacetone moiety from sedoheptulose-7-phosphate to glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate
The transfer of a two-carbon ketol group from xylulose-5-phosphate to ribose-5-phosphate

questions.question: The Digestible Indispensable Amino Acid Score (DIAAS) was recommended by the FAO to replace the older Protein Digestibility-Corrected Amino Acid Score (PDCAAS) for protein quality assessment. What is a key physiological improvement introduced by the DIAAS method?
options: It calculates true ileal amino acid digestibility rather than fecal amino acid digestibility.
It truncates the final protein quality score to 1.00 to avoid overestimating high-quality protein sources.
It uses fecal nitrogen balance measured in adult humans rather than ileal digestibilities from pig models.
It factors in colonic bacterial amino acid synthesis to adjust for non-protein nitrogen.
